title: fix(cli): document partial agent updates and check login in agents sync
author: Connectslide121

gist.summary: Added a login check to `polli agents sync`, so logged-out users get `Not logged in. Run: polli auth login` instead of a raw 401. Updated SKILL.md to explain that prompt-agent updates merge with the existing config, so callers should send only the fields they want to change; its recipe now includes `polli agents sync <id>`. Bumped `@pollinations/cli` to 0.1.36.

The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized, sharing the frame, never realistic, in cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874) glow and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
